# Get the details right

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Debugging with AI
- What: Give the AI the exact error and the steps that cause it, and have it find the cause before changing code.
- Applies when: every app.
- Stage: day-one
- Kind: practice

### Component library
- What: One shared set of buttons, inputs and dialogs, so every screen looks and behaves the same.
- Applies when: the app has screens.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: practice

### Guessable IDs
- What: Use ids in links that cannot be guessed by counting, such as 1, 2, 3.
- Applies when: ids appear in links or in the API.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: Ids in links and API responses are not counting numbers. Changing an id by one finds nothing.

### Account recovery
- What: A safe way for users who forgot their password to get back in.
- Applies when: users log in with a password.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: A reset link works once and expires. The reset page gives the same answer whether or not the email has an account.

### Soft delete
- What: Hide deleted items instead of erasing them at once, so they can be restored.
- Applies when: the user wants deleted items to be restorable.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: A deleted item disappears for the user and can be restored for a set period.
